title:
Triggers model training from a template, or opens the modal for it, according to payload.
On successful request, redirects to the ModelAssetDetail page for the asset.
If any of the parameters are not passed in, they will default to look at application state.
The payload accepts the following options:

showConfirmationModal: boolean - whether to open the confirmation modal first.
If true, the confirmation modal will be opened, and the fields will be stored in state.

assetPageParamName: string - page param storing the asset id to redirect to (defaults to id)

datasetComponent: string - dataSpec component containing the dataset id

pathToDatasetId: string - path to get the dataset id from the dataSpec

templateComponent: string - dataSpec component containing the template id

pathToTemplateId: string - path to get the template id from the dataSpec
name: ModelConfigTrainFromTemplateEpic
